description: A residential backyard swimming pool photographed from an elevated angle above and to the side, looking down at roughly 45 degrees in a wide establishing shot. The pool is a kidney or free-form shaped in-ground pool with bright aquamarine blue water and a dark stone coping edge. Multiple glowing floating spheres rest on the pool surface, each emitting a different color — red, pink, lavender, blue, and white — creating a colorful festive ring of illuminated bubbles across the water. The pool coping is natural sandstone or travertine pavers in a warm buff-cream tone, and the surrounding pool deck continues in the same material. Two low-profile teak or natural wood slatted chaise lounges with cream cushions are positioned near the pool edge, shaded by a large taupe canvas patio umbrella. The backyard is densely planted with mature deciduous and evergreen trees, with a tall natural wood fence enclosing the space; lush green shrubs, tropical plants, and ornamental grasses border the pool perimeter. The overall atmosphere is playful, summer-festive, and domestic. The color palette is bright aqua blue, warm buff stone, deep green foliage, and vivid saturated chromatic accents from the illuminated floating spheres.
